description: Fatty acid profile (saturated, mono/polyunsaturated, omega-3/6, EPA, DHA, trans, and individual acids) of one TACO food by id, per 100 g or scaled to grams. Only 423 of 597 foods have it; others return available:false (not zero). Tr is {"trace":true}, missing is null.

food_id.description: TACO food number, as returned by search_food.

grams.description: Quantity in grams of edible portion. Omit for the table basis of 100 g.

nutrients.description: Keys to return (e.g. "saturated_g", "dha_c22_6_g", "c18_3_n3_g"). Omit for all.

name: get_fatty_acids

available.description: False when this TACO table has no row for the food. That is missing data, not zero: nutrients is empty.

basis_grams.description: Quantity the amounts refer to, in grams of edible portion.

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

foods_with_data.description: Only when available is false and the table is small: the foods it does cover.

not_analyzed_nutrients.description: Keys with no value in the TACO table; not zero.

notes.description: Caveats about this table, this food or this answer.

nutrients.description: Requested entries, in table order. Empty when available is false.

amount.description: Value for basis_grams (equals per_100g when not scaled).

key.description: Key of the fatty acid or amino acid.

per_100g.description: Value in the TACO table, per 100 g.

scaled.description: True when amounts were computed from the per-100 g table values for another quantity.

title: Get fatty acid profile of a food
